quest.title: The Gourmet Supremos: Foodie Quiz
quest.description: Parvaneh of the Gourmet Supremos seems to be troubled by something...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: This recipe should be like this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I'm sorting recipes out. Unfortunately, I can't remember some of them clearly...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Xudong... He and his "creative dishes" are the main reasons why I can't remember them.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Every time he gets hold of a new recipe, he'll only follow the recipe for a day or two at most.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Then, he... tries various things to improve them.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: According to him, it's to make them less expensive... But I'm not quite sure why he did all that...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: But anyway, the results speak for themselves. He was indeed successful.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: The taste is similar to the original, but the production cost is ridiculously low.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: His outrageous cooking methods are the reason why I was willing to work with him. And I think the reason he was willing to take me on is because of my skills.

choices.text: So, what do you want me to do for you?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Ah... whoops! I was so busy talking about Xudong that I almost forgot the topic at hand...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Xudong has been pestering me to change the recipes. He would write and draw directly on them... As such, some recipes have become hard to read.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I want to recover those recipes accurately and save a copy in case a proper one is needed.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Traveler, if you still remember them, could you help me out?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Thanks. So I'll sort out the messed-up recipes, and you can correct the unclear parts...

choices.text: Of course. I've been eating my way across Teyvat.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Haven't I told you? My research topic at Akademiya is the "ultimate seasoning."

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Simply put, I mean to create a super seasoning that can make any food delicious.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: That's the reason I'm out here to collect information on various cuisines.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Ahem, I've gone on too long. Let's get back to the recipes...

choices.text: How exactly would he improve them?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Well... his way is different from others. Most chefs try to make the recipe richer so that the dish can be sold at a higher price.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: But Xudong seems to have a completely different principle...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: For example, he used potatoes, mushrooms, and some other cheap vegetables to make a vegetarian dish which somehow tasted like Jueyun Chili Chicken...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: There is also this simplified version of Adeptus' Temptation made with Potatoes, Rice, Lotus Head, Jueyun Chili, dough, and Raw Meat. The texture and taste are somehow similar to the original dish...

choices.text: Wait. Aren't you The Gourmet Supremos?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Please don't mention that name to me again. These words will never appear in my paper...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Besides, Xudong and his "creative dishes" are the main reasons why I can't remember these recipes.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Well, thank you. I've written them all down now. I just hope that Xudong won't mess with them again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why would he do that?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Xudong only said that he wanted to make dishes cheaper.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I don't understand him at all... but he's really good at what he does.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I mean... with his skills, he'd be alright making anything. But why did he have to mess with these recipes...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Hmm... I can't help but feel that there is something off with these recipes...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Never mind. I'll just write them all down for now. Thank you for your help. I hope Xudong doesn't change them again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why would he do that?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Xudong only said that he wanted to make dishes cheaper.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I don't understand him at all... but he's really good at what he does.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I mean... with his skills, he'd be alright making anything. But why did he have to mess with these recipes...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: In Liyue, there is a dish called Bamboo Shoot Soup. It's supposed to be very delicate...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Xudong... he changed this one too...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: "Chop Snapdragon and boil it with Mushrooms. Add Salt and Sugar. The soup will taste like Ham."

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Who would cook these things together!? And even if the soup tasted like ham, it's not as if there would be any in there!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Forget it... Traveler, what I want to ask is: "Besides raw meat, what else is in Bamboo Shoot Soup?"

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Hmm... is that so? Let me write it down first...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Hmm... is that so? Let me write it down first...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: There is a dish called Tri-Flavored Skewer in Inazuma... ever since Uncle Munehisa taught Xudong this dish, he's been working hard on it...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I can't believe he made so many notes...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: "'Skewer' is such a wonderful word. Any ingredient can be skewered on a stick..."

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: What exactly does he want to skewer... Oh, forget it! Traveler, what I want to ask is: "besides Raw Meat, Flour, and Snapdragon, what else is needed for Tri-Flavored Skewer?"

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Hmm... is that so? Let me write it down first...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: There is a dish called Northern Apple Stew in Mondstadt. Ugh, Xudong wrote down a bunch of nonsense here again...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: "Butter is expensive and raw meat is hard to store. Why not knead the dough, wash out the gluten, steam the gluten, and season it with fruits and vegetables to give it a savory taste?"

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: This fellow... How is butter expensive? And why not just buy fresh meat?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Never mind... Traveler, what I want to ask is "besides Apples, Butter, and Raw Meat, what else is in Northern Apple Stew?"

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Hmm... is that so? Let me write it down first...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: There is a famous dish called Tianshu Meat in Liyue, let's see... Uh, Xudong scribbled something here, too...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: "Steam peeled potatoes, mash while hot, add oil and salt. Then put it in a bowl and pour a thick gravy on top. The first bite is just like soft meat."

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: The first bite... does that mean you can tell after a few more bites? Come on, that will only fool those who have never had genuine Tianshu Meat...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Forget it... Traveler, what I want to ask is: "besides Raw Meat, Sugar, and Matsutake, what else is in Tianshu Meat?"

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Hmm... is that so? Let me write it down first...

dialogues.text: There is a famous dish in Liyue called Black-Back Perch Stew...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: "...Violetgrass is hard to find. Boil Small Lamp Grass and Snapdragon together. Use the soup to make the dish, which will have the same taste."

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: How did Xudong come up with all this...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Never mind. Traveler, what I want to ask is: "besides Violetgrass, Jueyun Chili, and Fish, what else is needed in this dish?"
